job.title: Data Engineer
job.pay_full: $106,000 – $170,000 a year base salary in Zone A ($92,000 – $147,000 Zone B; $83,000 – $133,000 Zone C), plus equity, benefits and bonus/commissions if eligible

details.about: Toast builds technology that helps restaurants and local businesses run their operations, grow sales, engage customers and keep employees happy. This Data Engineer joins the Enterprise Data team, building and scaling the data platforms and pipelines behind insights across the company, working with Analytics, Engineering and Product.
duties: Build and maintain scalable, production-ready data pipelines end to end
Build data quality, observability, lineage and governance into every pipeline
Apply best practices for cost-efficient, performant cloud data infrastructure
Contribute to data platform tooling and frameworks for self-service analytics
Take part in code reviews, design discussions and architecture planning
Build semantic and metrics layer foundations (e.g. dbt metrics, Snowflake semantic layer) for AI applications and consistent KPIs
Help evolve the enterprise data domain model, including Customer 360
needs: 2+ years in data engineering, software engineering or a related role, building and maintaining production data systems
Strong SQL plus a language such as Python, Scala or Java
Familiarity with warehouses/lakehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Delta Lake
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT workflows with tools such as Airflow or dbt
Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing and pipeline design
Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders and collaboration with analytics, operations and product teams
nice: Cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure)
CI/CD, infrastructure as code or containers (e.g. Docker, Terraform)
Data governance, metadata management and observability tools
Data security, privacy and compliance in the cloud
details.benefits: Base salary by geographic pay zone: Zone A $106,000 – $170,000, Zone B $92,000 – $147,000, Zone C $83,000 – $133,000 a year; starting pay depends on skills, experience and location. Total rewards also include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity and benefits.
notes: Pay varies by geographic pay zone
